name: Figma Make
summary: Figma's prompt-to-app tool for turning ideas and designs into working prototypes and apps.
description: Figma Make is Figma's prompt-to-app product. It generates functional prototypes and web apps from prompts or existing Figma designs, and users can iterate through chat or edit the generated code. It is separate from the Figma design editor. It sits in Figma's product set alongside Design, Sites, Weave and Dev Mode. The Starter plan is free with limited access; the Professional full seat costs $16 per month and includes 3,000 AI credits per month.
